title: K-Pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind Ae-Aespa’S "Whiplash" Universe 🌐✨[En/Kr/Es/Cn/Jp/Fr/Pt Sub]
description:
Are you a K-pop fan? 🎶
Then you’ve probably noticed the jaw-dropping visuals that take performances to the next level. But who brings that magic to life behind the scenes?

Meet Jinbeom and Jon — two visionary creators behind @aespa ae-aespa’s Whiplash Universe. Using digital garments to amplify realism and impact, they turned bold ideas into striking visuals. 💥✨

Built within the same ecosystem, Marvelous Designer and CLO offer a unified 3D design experience. This cross-platform synergy is blurring the lines between fashion, tech, and entertainment — and redefining what's possible in digital creation.

💡🧵 Watch how it all came together in this behind-the-scenes story.
